claims.claim_text_normalized: Cascade R-CNN is a multi-stage object detection architecture that addresses overfitting and inference-time mismatch.
claims.evidence_quote_short: A multi-stage object detection architecture, the Cascade R-CNN, is proposed to address these problems.

claims.claim_text_normalized: Cascade R-CNN surpasses all single-model object detectors on the COCO dataset.
claims.evidence_quote_short: A simple implementation of the Cascade R-CNN is shown to surpass all single-model object detectors on the challenging COCO dataset.

claims.claim_text_normalized: Cascade R-CNN achieves consistent gains across detector architectures independently of baseline strength.
claims.evidence_quote_short: Experiments also show that the Cascade R-CNN is widely applicable across detector architectures, achieving consistent gains independently of the baseline detector strength.

claims.claim_text_normalized: Training a detector with a high IoU threshold can degrade detection performance due to overfitting.
claims.evidence_quote_short: However, detection performance tends to degrade with increasing the IoU thresholds.

claims.claim_text_normalized: A single detector can only be optimal for a single quality level.
claims.evidence_quote_short: The basic idea is that a single detector can only be optimal for a single quality level.

claims.claim_text_normalized: The output IoU of a regressor is almost invariably better than the input IoU.
claims.evidence_quote_short: This is motivated by the observation that the output IoU of a regressor is almost invariably better than the input IoU.

claims.claim_text_normalized: Cascade R-CNN improves localization performance over iterative bounding box regression.
claims.evidence_quote_short: The cascade regressor has better performance at later stages, outperforming iterative BBox at almost all IoU levels.

claims.claim_text_normalized: The Cascade R-CNN outperforms the integral loss detector across all IoU evaluation metrics.
claims.evidence_quote_short: The cascade R-CNN has the best performance for all evaluation metrics.
